title: Bhakta Prahlada
desc: Prince Prahlada, the pious son of an asura king, must endure his father's wrath due to his unmoving devotion towards Lord Vishnu.

title: Jeevana Chaitra
desc: A man discovers that alcohol is a major problem in the villages, where men buy alcohol with the minimal money they have and do not work, while the wives and children get neglected and abused.

title: Gajanana & Gang
desc: Gaja, a young man known for his calm demeanour, is forced to join hands with his college friends and rebel against his seniors after they display unruly behaviour.

title: Chellata
desc: In order to secure money for his sister's dowry, Ganesh invests his money in a business, only to lose it. During this process, a rich woman falls in love with him, unaware of his financial condition.

title: Krishnana Veera Prema Kathe
desc: Krishna loves Mahalakshmi, whose brother works for a don. During a gang fight, the brother asks Krishna to protect some children and return them to their parents.

title: Lakshmana
desc: A couple in love harbour dark secrets from each other. When the two realise that they share the same goal, which is to avenge the deaths of their families, their paths align.

title: Naani
desc: Soon after moving into their new palatial house, a couple begins experiencing paranormal phenomena. An investigation leads them to the chilling story of the house's previous inhabitants.
